_comment: News items for news.html and the 3 most recent on the home page. Order does not matter; they are sorted newest first. Each entry: date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), headline (one line), url (optional, leave empty for none), detail (optional short sentence after the headline).

news.headline: Started a new project mapping the prompt-response landscape of foundation segmentation models.
Joined the Georgia Tech Research Institute's ATAS Lab as a research intern for the summer.
Completed my M.Sc. in Computer Science (Machine Learning) at Georgia Tech.
Started my PhD in Machine Learning at Georgia Tech, with a minor in Materials Science.
Our paper on semi-automatic AFM image analysis for cellulose nanocrystal size measurement was published in Cellulose.
Presented a poster at the International Conference on Nanotechnology for Renewable Materials.
Presented a poster at the MRS Spring Meeting.
